tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Authenticates the provided Kagi tenant API key, executes a search for the query string, persists an audit/billing log entry containing the request and the returned payload, and returns the search results (up to `limit`, defaulting to the service default when omitted; this endpoint does not paginate). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when `api_key` is missing, invalid, or not permitted for search, VALIDATION_ERROR when `q` is missing/empty or `limit` is outside 1–50, and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS when the tenant exceeds its rate limit or quota. Raises UPSTREAM_ERROR when the search engine cannot fulfill the request and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected failures while recording the request/response log.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and attribute the request.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the provided Kagi tenant API key, including the resolved workspace, key status, allowed tools, effective monthly quota, and current calendar-month usage. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and attribute the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search query audit records for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered by status, api_key_id, tool_name, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by created_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and scope results to a workspace.

api_key_id.description: Filter to a specific API key id within the workspace.

created_after.description: Include only queries created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

created_before.description: Include only queries created before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single search query audit record by id within the authenticated workspace. Returns the stored request metadata and execution outcome fields. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist in the workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and scope access.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_response
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the persisted response payload record for a given search query id (unique per query). Returns response metadata and any stored response_json/response_text unless redacted or purged. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if no response exists for the query in the workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and scope access.

query_id.description: Search query id whose response should be returned.

tool_schemas.name: list_usage_ledger
tool_schemas.description: Lists usage ledger events for the authenticated workspace for auditing and quota verification, optionally filtered by api_key_id, query_id, event_type, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by occurred_at descending. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and scope results to a workspace.

api_key_id.description: Filter to a specific API key id within the workspace.

query_id.description: Filter to a specific query id.

occurred_after.description: Include only events occurring at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

occurred_before.description: Include only events occurring before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

tool_schemas.name: update_search_response_status
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a stored search response to a new lifecycle state to support retention controls (stored→redacted→purged or stored→purged). When purging, the service nulls response_json and response_text and marks status='purged'. Refuses with INVALID_REQUEST if the transition is not allowed, NOT_FOUND if the response id does not exist in the workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing/invalid/revoked or the workspace is not active.

api_key.description: Kagi tenant API key used to authenticate and scope the operation.

status.description: Target status transition for the response.

redaction_reason.description: Optional reason recorded when moving to 'redacted' or 'purged' (if supported by the backend).

purge_now.description: When true and status='purged', purge immediately; otherwise the service may schedule purge according to retention policy.

metadata.name: Kagi
metadata.description: This backend stores Kagi API tenants and credentials, plus a durable log of search requests and the corresponding result payloads returned to clients. The main workflow is: authenticate an API key, accept a search request, dispatch to the search engine, store the query and response for auditing/bill
